verdict.rationale: llamafile documents a built-in HTTP server mode with an API (`--server` options covering HTTP server, API, Web UI) and describes itself as model, runtime, and server in one file, so an agent could plausibly use it as a local backend. The evidence never says the API is OpenAI-compatible, never mentions tool or function calling, and never shows any coding agent connected to it. missing for 10: documented OpenAI-compatible endpoint, tool/function-calling support, documented integration with any coding agent, hands-on reports of agent use as a working backend.
